subject: Discovery Recap: AtlasCommerce - Embeddings & Reranking
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@atlascommerce.com>, Nina Patel <nina@atlascommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery Recap: AtlasCommerce - Embeddings & Reranking

Hi Oliver / Nina,

Thanks again for the call today - great to meet you both. Below is a short recap to make sure we captured AtlasCommerce's goals and next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Search quality on product pages is inconsistent for long-tail queries and category synonyms; relevance drops for new SKUs.
- Current vector search adds cost and latency spikes during peak catalog updates.
- Hard to rerank results without bloating infra costs - manual heuristics are brittle.

Current stack you shared:
- Primary search: Elasticsearch 8.x for pure-text baseline.
- Vector DB: Milvus behind a small K8s cluster (self-managed).
- Embeddings: Open-source encoder (sentence-transformers) run on CPU.
- Serving: Node.js service that merges ES + Milvus candidates and applies a LightGBM reranker.

Success criteria for a pilot (what 'good' looks like):
- Relevance improvement: +12-18% NDCG on held-out queries.
- Latency target: 95th percentile end-to-end < 220ms for interactive search (web).
- Cost target: keep infra token/compute costs <= current spend for rerank (or show clear ROI).
- Index scale: ~18M product vectors today, expected growth to 30M in 12 months.
- Batch/update pattern: nightly full re-index, incremental real-time adds (~500-1k vectors/hour during daytime).

Constraints / non-starters:
- Atlas cannot send raw PII off-net - pilot needs to run in your cloud account or on a VPC-private deployment.
- SOC2 evidence is required before production.

Suggested next steps (we agreed on):
1) I'll send a mutual action plan + short SOW for a 6-8 week pilot (scope: embeddings quality + rerank proof-of-concept).
2) Atlas to share: (a) a sample of 100K product records + current feature set, (b) latency/cost targets from your infra team, (c) a copy of the Milvus version and current cluster size.
3) Tech sync w/ your infra (TBD) to confirm VPC/private deployment options and data access.

Attachments: I've attached a quick template for the sample export + our SOC2 checklist to speed review.

If this looks good I'll follow up with the MAP and a calendar invite for the tech sync.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
redwood.ai

--

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@atlascommerce.com>

Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discovery Recap: AtlasCommerce - Embeddings & Reranking

Thanks Marissa - this is perfect and captures everything. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 18M vector count is across two catalogs (US + EU). The pilot will use the US catalog initially (~11M vectors).
- Nightly re-index is done with a 6-hour window (we do delta extraction first). Real-time adds are closer to 700 vectors/hour on weekdays.
- Our latency target for the web UI is tighter at 200ms p95 if possible - we can tolerate up to 250ms for batch/rerank endpoints.

We'll share the sample export (100K) and the Milvus cluster specs by EOD Tuesday. SOC2 docs are on a secure share; Nina will confirm access.

Also: can you confirm Redwood's recommended vector dimensionality and whether you support asymmetric hashing or quantized indices for cost control?

Oliver
Head of Search Engineering
AtlasCommerce
oliver@atlascommerce.com
